name: GKD Pixel 2

pad.note: gamekiddy-joypad driver; the same by-path EVENT_PATH as the twig Pixel2.cfg's pad

power.note: dArkMossCommon.sh finds the rk817 pwrkey node by name at boot

vol.note: dArkMossCommon.sh finds the gpio-keys node by its KEY_VOLUMEUP/DOWN capability bits at boot; cfg's static EVENT_PATH_VOLUME=EVENT_PATH_POWER is only the pre-resolution fallback

absent.LEFT_STICK: no analog stick (DEVICE_NUM_ANALOG_STICKS=0); STICK_* are DOESNT_EXIST in the cfg
absent.FN_LEFT: none on this cfg (B_L3/B_R3=DOESNT_EXIST here); see the notes on the twig Pixel2.cfg conflict
absent.FN_RIGHT: none on this cfg (B_L3/B_R3=DOESNT_EXIST here); see the notes on the twig Pixel2.cfg conflict

notes: Boot, sound and rumble were seen on a unit 2026-10-27 (cfg header), but no per-button press capture exists in this workspace, so codes here are cfg-level.

B_L3/B_R3 are DOESNT_EXIST here, but the twig Pixel2.cfg (same physical GKD Pixel 2, same gamekiddy-joypad EVENT_PATH) declares B_L3=1 317/B_R3=1 318 with a comment that they "also log left/right fnkey stuff." Kept per this platform's own cfg (the newer of the two, dated 2026-10-27 boot evidence); not reconciled. A hardware run on this dArkMoss image should check whether 317/318 ever fire before trusting either side.
